rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no AXES declared, so nothing moves
rows.source: a static assembly is fully judged by the fit rule; declare AXES in assembly.py for a machine

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 1730.1 × 701.3 mm across 2 bodies at z = -0.00 (oven_stand, pnp_v4)
rows.limit: at least 5 mm in both axes
rows.source: union of the contact patches at the lowest plane; a span near zero in either axis is a line or point contact and will tip. Does not test the centre of mass.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 2 bodies on the plane, 5 above it, none below
rows.source: the lowest plane is taken as the ground, so nothing can be below it by construction; this row records the split

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no mass for 6 of 7 bodies: board_oven (bought part 'board' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); board_pnp (bought part 'board' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); oven_stand (bought part 'riser' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); pnp_conveyor (bought part 'pnp_conveyor' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); pnp_v4 (bought part 'pnp_v4' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); rail_blocks (stock: assembly.py builds it itself; make it a part module with a MATERIAL or a bought part with a mass)
rows.source: made: volume x density of its MATERIAL; bought: declared mass_g with a mass_source; a stock body has none
